Title: Station Head
Text: Good Morning, Control. Welcome to station. Your first order of business should be rebuilding our network, recent events have left us somewhat thin.

Title: Anais
Text: Anais runs a flower shop in the old city. She sends coded messages to $AGENT by arranging the window display.

Title: In Danger
Text: Anais put four red carnations in the window display. That's her emergency signal!
PromptRight: Send an extraction team. Let's get her to safety. Cmd:Extract()
PromptLeft: Stop in to her shop. See what she needs. Cmd:Remove(anais) Cmd:Add(anais-captured)

Title: Paranoia Strikes Deep
Text: $ASSET reports feeling as if they are being watched.
PromptRight: They should go to ground for a while. Cmd:Discard($ASSET)
